## Summary

Let power users tune **Continuous view & format** numeric settings **beyond current slider min/max clamps** — either by widening ranges substantially or by offering an **advanced numeric entry** path (text input / "no clamp") so imported or hand-typed values are not silently truncated.

Today every control in `ContinuousViewFormatDialog` is a `Slider` with hard-coded minimum and maximum in `BuildSliders()`; values outside those bound… (truncated, use `get_issue` for full description)
title: Format settings: unbounded or liberal numeric bounds (advanced entry)
